sentences.en: Once more, fundamentalist ideologies are opposed to great historical advances.

sentences.en: Constantine the Great is discussed controversively in modern historical research.

sentences.en: A fierce battle led to an historical victory for Sweden.
sentences.zh: 3. 一场激烈的战斗导致瑞典取得了历史性胜利。
